name: Studley Royal Park including the Ruins of Fountains Abbey
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Near Ripon in North Yorkshire, the roofless stone arches of Fountains Abbey rise from a green valley. Cistercian monks founded it in 1132, and it grew into one of England's richest monasteries before its closure in 1539. In the 1700s the ruins became the centrepiece of Studley Royal's Georgian water garden, with still canals, clipped lawns and carefully framed views.
